description: rho0 -> pi+pi- helicity amplitudes (Diehl notation, T and U, nucleon non-flip) plus the pi+pi- S-wave, extracted from CLAS12 RGA/RGK data (6.395, 8.477, 10.6 GeV) by the per-bin unbinned likelihood fit with the 7-D acceptance.
content: 51 (Q2, xB, |t|) nodes x 22 parameters (16 P-wave + 6 S-wave); |A|^2 = 7-term smooth model in (log Q2, log xB, |t|) times per-node rate calibration; amplitude direction interpolated linearly between nodes
helicity_convention: RGA (RGK beam helicity flipped to RGA before the fit)
validation: angular shapes close to data (corrected-level shape chi2 cos 60/7, phi_H 83/11, Phi 53/11); W and xB shapes and the absolute yield are limited by the rho0 FastMC used for the rate calibration (fiducial yield ratio data/gen 1.17/1.10/1.10 at 6.4/8.5/10.6 GeV), see vecmeson_extraction FINDINGS 2026-11-05
defaults_note: 2026-11-06 production windows. Minima for all beams: Q2 > 0.8, xB > 0.05, W > 1.8, -t > 0.1 GeV^2 (t < 0). Upper edges per beam = the 99.9th percentile of the selected data (selection cuts only, no analysis box; phi: DISANA RGK 6.535 / 7.546 and RGA Fall 2018 + Spring 2018 outbending; rho0: Harut's RGK 6.395 / 8.477 and RGA 10.6 outbending skims with his cuts and 0.5 < m(pipi) < 0.9), rounded up. TMAX (t' bound) = ABSTMAX, as t' <= |t|. Outside 'coverage' the amplitudes are extrapolated.
